text: Claude review of HL-12 authority at 7600943 (tree 2fd41b91; migrations f59dc7d2 and 452a94e5), composed HTTP->service->repository->PostgREST v14.13->PG 17.6 with exact bytes. SHARED SQL INVARIANTS PASS: quote from immutable lines, owner-bound read/accept (foreign/no-cred 404, token 200), stale/superseded/expired refused, accepted quote immutable, 1c under/over, EUR, usd refused, no-grant 403, body-injected verifier 403, cross-path 404, obsolete unbound verify 42501, forged cross-order verification id refused, atomic, 1 verification + 1 paid event, identical retry replays, concurrent verify 1/1 with 0 rollbacks and no hang, historical paid frozen, cancel-after-paid refused in SQL. 495 unit tests pass, tsc 0, DAG 42. FINDINGS, in fix order: F1 P1 production composes AssistedOrderFinanceService(..., null), so manual observe always returns 409 manual_evidence_unavailable; no grant procedure exists (SQL insert only). Implement a real independent ledger authority with durable single use and an audited grant procedure. F2 P1 verified paid cannot reach fulfillment: service.ts:837 refuses every exit from paid (HTTP 409) while SQL allows it once a verification exists. Condition the TS refusal on the absence of a verification. F3 P2 one wrong manual observation blocks the order forever: the reference must equal the request ref and (method,payment_reference) is unique+immutable, so a corrected observation gets 409 payment_reference_reused. Add a governed void/supersede for unverified observations or key on the external evidence id. F4 P2 verify sets paid inside SQL: 0 customer notification intents and no TS audit. Enqueue both from verifyManual, idempotent on verification id. F5 P2 source_evidence_ref not unique; SQL accepts one bank evidence for two orders. Add unique (method, source_evidence_ref) or a durable single-use ledger. F6 P2 payment_review->cancelled after an observation exists needs only free text. F7 P2 status copy inverted: after real verification the assisted-order page says 'Payment record under review' while /status says 'Payment verified'. Render paid copy from verification existence on both surfaces and in notifications. F8 P3 supplier_processing->cancelled over HTTP returns 500 (REFUND_AUTHORITY_NOT_READY unmapped). F9 P3 verifier must equal observer (no two-person control); needs a founder decision. Card adapter NOT PRESENT. Report + harness: 18_REVIEW_7600943_HL12_AUTHORITY.md, sql/composed/hl12-finance-probe.mts.
